messages:
Ava (Design): Quick design check — thinking of adding a small 'Copy' affordance next to the Correlation ID in the request drilldown. Placement suggestions? @Sam @Leo :eyes:
Sam (Product): I like it. We should decide on wording: 'Copy ID' vs 'Copy correlation ID' vs 'Copy request ID'. My vote: 'Copy correlation ID' — clearer for engineers and support folks.
Leo (Eng-runtime): Placing it inline right after the ID makes sense. FYI impl notes: use Clipboard API and ensure keyboard focus. Also watch for long IDs — maybe show truncated ID with tooltip/full value on hover.
Maya (Accessibility): Strong rec: use an actual <button> element (not a div) and add clear aria-label. Example: `aria-label="Copy correlation ID to clipboard"`. Announce success with `aria-live="polite"`. Also ensure focus outline is visible.
Ava (Design): Good calls. UX Q: should the button be icon-only or icon+label? Icon-only saves space but may be ambiguous in small widths.
Sam (Product): Icon-only ok if we keep a tooltip and accessible label. Also think about mobile: touch target should be >=44px.
Leo (Eng-runtime): Technical edge-case: when users try to select the ID text to copy manually, the copy button must not steal focus or prevent selection. We can make the ID selectable and keep the button separate to the right.
Maya (Accessibility): Also add keyboard support: button should be reachable via Tab, and pressing Enter/Space triggers copy. Consider offering a keyboard shortcut when drilldown has focus (e.g., press 'c' to copy) but be careful about conflicts.
Ava (Design): Another thought — should copying produce a transient toast that says 'Correlation ID copied' or a less intrusive inline label? Toast is fine if it doesn't block. Use consistent microcopy across the console.
Sam (Product): Related: export actions (Download trace / Export JSON) are in the header menu — do we want a separate 'Download snapshot' button next to Copy? Might be overkill. Leaning to keep export in menu, copy inline.
Leo (Eng-runtime): Implementation note: for very large traces we should avoid copying the full payload by accident. Copy only the ID string. If we add a 'Copy trace' action later, make it explicit.
Maya (Accessibility): Add to checklist: aria-label, role=button if not using <button>, visible focus, aria-live announcement, and tooltip accessible via keyboard. I'll draft checklist items.
deploy-bot: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/patches/482 — includes icon button, aria-label, and tests for keyboard interactions.
Ava (Design): Thanks — I'll iterate the mockups with icon+tooltip and a 44px touch target. Will post a prototype Wednesday.
Leo (Eng-runtime): I'll prototype keyboard handlers and ensure selection isn't blocked; will add unit tests for Clipboard and focus.
Maya (Accessibility): I'll review the prototype and checklist. If we keep icon-only, I'll request an always-present visible tooltip on hover/focus.
Ava (Design): Action items: Ava — updated mock by Wed; Leo — keyboard + selection prototype; Maya — accessibility checklist and review. Back here after prototypes. :v:
